assumptions.statement: A maintenance window is available and acceptable for the switchover, allowing for data synchronization and DNS changes.
assumptions.quote: a small maintenance window is necessary to sync data and switch DNS

assumptions.statement: The organization can afford the increased costs of maintaining full stacks on both the current platform and AWS during the testing phase.
assumptions.quote: During the testing phase, there will be an increase in costs as the full stack is maintained on the current platform as well as a full stack in AWS.

assumptions.statement: The team lacks the capacity or strict planning discipline to manage a long-term dual-platform operation with separate monitoring and infrastructure.
assumptions.quote: we risk running on two platforms with all the extra work that creates for a long period of time if we don't migrate atomically
